note: Straight-alpha RGBA layers, far to near. Each PNG includes the overscan margin; place its top-left at `offset` in painting coordinates. depth: suggested parallax factor (0 = sky ... 1 = nearest). flat.png = all layers composited with normal blending.

layers.name: sky
layers.note: amber-to-blue dawn sky; bright sun disc with a painted halo at upper right (where the trail ends); opaque

layers.name: high_clouds
layers.note: large sculpted cloud forms + soft lenses, upper left (clear of the trail)

layers.name: ridge
layers.note: distant ridge breaking through the cloud sea under the sun

layers.name: cloud_sea
layers.note: the far sea of clouds: irregular cumulus of varied scale in perspective

layers.name: clouds_mid
layers.note: sculpted cumulus banks rising from the sea (right half)

layers.name: clouds_near
layers.note: big near cumulus at the bottom right

layers.name: fg
layers.note: forest canopy tops at the bottom-left edge (the launch point of the trail)

camera: slow pan across 2400 px; any 1920-wide window is composed
